title: Failure category
description: The category of a failure or of an error code (REQ-FLT-001). `validation` and `configuration` are the categories of the first error codes; `internal` (T-03.7) is a failure of the library itself while it did its work (a port or a step failed), never a mistake of the caller. Each capability adds its own values as it is built, and adding a value is a MINOR change of the contract (REQ-VER-003). The AI error categories live in enums/ai/ (REQ-AI-005).
